title.zh: Global financial watchdog calls for cross-border information sharing, planning for stablecoin crisis
title.en: Global financial watchdog calls for cross-border information sharing, planning for stablecoin crisis

current_state.zh: A global financial watchdog urged regulators to establish cross-border information-sharing and crisis-response plans for stablecoins, warning that jointly issued multi-jurisdiction coins can leave reserves stranded in one country while redemption demands surge in another.
current_state.en: A global financial watchdog urged regulators to establish cross-border information-sharing and crisis-response plans for stablecoins, warning that jointly issued multi-jurisdiction coins can leave reserves stranded in one country while redemption demands surge in another.
